data: Prekrasno je nedjeljno jutro. Ona se budi i gleda ga kako ukrcava zadnje komade namještaja u kamion. Dok beba mirno spava, njih dvoje broje zadnje sate u svojem domu čekajući deložaciju. Budućnost je nesigurna, ali izbor pred njima jednostavan je. Moraju odlučiti hoće li prihvatiti nepravdu ili joj se oduprijeti. (A wellness weekend for three friends is in danger of derailing: Marlene is in a serious midlife crisis and is looking for a sex date. She accompanies the divorced Eva and her ex-husband's new wife to protect them from stupid things. Unfortunately, the three seem to attract chaos almost magically.)

Budućnost je nesigurna, ali izbor pred njima jednostavan je. Moraju odlučiti hoće li prihvatiti nepravdu ili joj se oduprijeti.

A wellness weekend for three friends is in danger of derailing: Marlene is in a serious midlife crisis and is looking for a sex date. She accompanies the divorced Eva and her ex-husband's new wife to protect them from stupid things. Unfortunately, the three seem to attract chaos almost magically.
